project_metadata.title: AI Elements Documentation and Integration Guide
project_metadata.objective: Pivot from custom ReAct engine (ahizan-ai V1) to Vercel AI SDK V2 enterprise architecture

sources.title: Contexte & Objectifs V2 (Pivot vers Vercel AI SDK & Console Admin)
Analyse Technique Complète de l'Existant (ahizan-ai V1)

ahizan_ai_v1_audit.stack: Node.js (v20+) pure TypeScript, 0 external npm dependencies, native node:http server on port 3005

architecture.gateway: Custom REST gateway supporting Google Gemini, OpenRouter/DeepSeek, and deterministic local MockProvider
architecture.react_engine: Hand-crafted ReAct (Reasoning + Acting) loop capped at 5 steps
architecture.tool_registry: GraphQL client connected to Vendure Admin API (products, sales, duplicate detection, FQS audit)

bottlenecks: Lack of response streaming (responses sent in blocking chunks)
Fragile manual maintenance of vendor tool-calling formats
No schema validation (lacks Zod / Structured Outputs)
Absence of dynamic admin configuration playground
ahizan_ai_v1_audit.v2_goals: Adopt Vercel AI SDK (@ai-sdk) for standardized streaming, tool execution, and modular admin console

vercel_ai_sdk.type: Universal Framework-Agnostic AI Layer (React, Vue, Node.js, Next.js)
features: Support for 100+ LLM models with unified API
Zod schema validation for structured outputs
AI SDK Core (backend) and AI SDK UI (useChat, useCompletion)
Thread subscription and mention listening (onNewMention, onReaction)
JSX-based rich cards rendering across channels

workflow_sdk.type: Durable execution framework for TypeScript functions
features: Automatic state persistence and step checkpointing
Long-running sleep capabilities without resource consumption (e.g. sleep('7 days'))
Built-in exponential retries and failure recovery
Observability and audit trace per workflow execution
Seamless integration with AI SDK for reliable agentic flows

eve_framework.type: Directory-structured agentic framework (Next.js paradigm for AI agents)

ai_elements.type: AI-native UI component registry built on shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS 4

flags_sdk.type: Server-only feature flags library as code
features: Compatible with any flag provider or custom logic
